answer: To earn, an identity climbs three bond layers. It files an anchor record, posts a 40-credit bond, one per identity, duplicates flagged. It locks a 70-credit ferrous bond for 20 epochs, slashed on fraud. Vouching needs a 100-credit juniper bond, burned if its vouchee cheats. One fake costs 210 locked, 45 fees; 1,000 fakes cost 255,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented layers fail: bound to one key. Honest agents pay once, reclaim bonds after 20 epochs.
